global: This shoyu ramen boasts a rich, dark broth, topped with halved soft-boiled eggs, nori, chashu, and menma, artfully arranged. Served in a patterned bowl, it rests on a wooden table under warm, ambient light.

regions.background: Dark wooden table with visible grain patterns and subtle texture, showing natural wood surface details.
regions.bowl: White ceramic bowl with blue geometric and cloud patterns, smooth glossy surface, slightly flared rim.
regions.soup: Shoyu ramen broth with noodles, green garnish, and visible broth surface, appearing rich, amber-brown, and glossy.
regions.cut_egg: A halved boiled egg shows a runny orange yolk and firm white, with a glossy surface and slight brown spot.
regions.seaweed: Dark, glossy nori seaweed, irregularly shaped with textured surface, curls slightly at edges.
regions.meat: Chashu pork: browned, tender-looking slices with visible fat marbling and slightly glistening surface.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear as thin, brownish, slightly curled strips with a fibrous texture and glossy surface.
